text: The first image places me before a glass-walled meeting room, neat and symmetrical yet totally empty—the absence of people invites contemplation about collaboration and solitude. I sense anticipation lingering in the sterile air. The second image brings me before an exhibit rich in color and text, boldly celebrating research and development. I feel intellectually curious here, energized by the promise implicit in innovation and the sharing of new ideas. Together these spaces evoke a contrast between silent preparation and the vibrant exchange of knowledge. I find myself at a threshold, ready to step forward with both questions and an open mind.
